title: 3BR/2BA custom home in gated Rancho Murieta North
description:
Welcome to this stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bath 2100 square foot, custom home tucked away at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac in the desirable gated community of Rancho Murieta North, with a 24/7 security guard.

Surrounded by mature trees and boasting beautiful curb appeal, this inviting home features dramatic high ceilings, abundant natural light from clerestory windows, and a versatile layout with formal living, family, and dining rooms, plus a bonus room perfect for a home office, loft, or playroom.

Enjoy cozy luxury carpeting in the bedrooms and living room, gorgeous engineered hardwood floors in the rest of the house, and a well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances and convenient built-in storage throughout. Additional features include central HVAC, a whole-house fan, and elegant window shutters.

A beautiful blend of comfort, style, and functionality in a peaceful setting ready to welcome you home!
$3850 monthly
Pets welcome
Location: Lobo Drive, Rancho Murieta, CA
